Senior DevOps Engineer
Bucharest, Romania or remote
 About The Role
 We’re looking for a seasoned Senior DevOps Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure across multiple cloud platforms (AWS preferred). You’ll own our Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) workflows, CI/CD pipelines in github, container orchestration, and integrations into cloud marketplaces.
Key Responsibilities
Cloud Infrastructure: Design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure AWS (and multi-cloud) architectures using best practices for networking, security, and cost optimization 
Infrastructure as Code: Develop, review, and enhance Terraform modules and CI workflows; enforce IaC best practices and module reuse 
CI/CD Pipelines: Build and manage automated build, test, and deployment pipelines (e.g., Jest, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline) to enable rapid, reliable releases 
Containerization & Orchestration: Containerize applications with Docker and manage Kubernetes clusters (EKS/GKE/AKS) for production and development workloads 
Monitoring & Alerting: Implement observability solutions (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) to ensure service reliability and performance. 
Security & Compliance: Embed security controls and compliance checks into pipelines and infrastructure; collaborate with InfoSec to remediate vulnerabilities. Familiarity with Keycloak token management and Infisicial secrets management preferred. 
Cloud Marketplace Integration: Package, publish, and maintain offerings on AWS Marketplace (and/or Google Cloud Marketplace/Azure Marketplace) to streamline customer procurement and deployment 
Collaboration & Documentation: Partner with engineering teams on architecture reviews, troubleshoot production incidents, and document standards, runbooks, and playbooks. 
 Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field 
5+ years in DevOps or Cloud Engineering roles 
3+ years hands-on with AWS core services (EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM) 
Proven Terraform experience (1+ year in production) 
Strong Docker and Kubernetes (EKS/GKE/AKS) expertise 
Solid scripting skills (Python, Bash, Powershell, etc.) 
Demonstrated ability designing and operating CI/CD pipelines 
Deep understanding of cloud networking, security, and compliance 
Ability to work cross platform OS 
 Preferred Qualifications
Experience with other clouds (Azure, GCP) 
Familiarity with additional IaC tools (CloudFormation, Pulumi) 
Prior work packaging solutions for public cloud marketplaces or partner portals 
Knowledge of GitOps tools (e.g., Argo CD) 
AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional)
